exam_scheme.note: The Footwear Design & Development Institute All India Selection Test (FDDI AIST) is conducted by the Footwear Design & Development Institute (FDDI), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, for admission into undergraduate (B.Des in Footwear Design & Production, Fashion Leather Accessory Design, and Textile & Apparel Design; BBA) and postgraduate (M.Des, MBA) programmes across its 12 campuses nationwide (Noida, Fursatganj, Chennai, Kolkata, Rohtak, Chhindwara, Guna, Jodhpur, Ankleshwar, Patna, Hyderabad, and Chandigarh). For undergraduate design programmes (B.Des), the AIST is a computer-based or paper-based test of 150 minutes (2.5 hours) duration comprising 150 questions carrying a total of 200 marks across five sections: Section 1 Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 25 marks), Section 2 Verbal Ability (30 questions, 30 marks), Section 3 General Awareness (30 questions, 30 marks), Section 4 Business Aptitude (25 questions, 25 marks), and Section 5 Design Aptitude (40 questions, 90 marks). There is no negative marking for incorrect attempts in FDDI AIST.
